---
title: "How to highlight information"
order: 1
---

This module demonstrates how to use callout boxes to highlight information in your training content, and how to make callouts collapsible so participants can choose when to view additional details. Each topic presents the Markdown and Quarto syntax alongside the rendered result, so you can see how different callouts appear to participants.

Explore the examples, copy the snippets you need, and adapt them for your own training pages.

<br>

## In this module

- [**Topic 1 – Callout boxes:**](/content/module-2/callout-boxes.qmd) Use notes, tips, important messages, cautions, and warnings to draw attention to different types of information.
- [**Topic 2 – Collapsible callout boxes:**](/content/module-2/collapsible-boxes.qmd) Make callouts expandable so supplementary information is available when participants need it.
